tracks.title: The Hollow Square (Live at Independence Stadium)
tracks.loreNote: Recorded August 15, 1985 before 90,000 fans at Independence Stadium in Philadelphia—Fractured Prisms' first-ever live concert. Enforcing the 'Sacred Perimeter' and 'Session Ghosts' stage manifesto, Rhys and Claire delivered an extended 5:24 stadium rendition of their #1 anthem featuring an opening solo on Gwen's wooden flute.
